name: KokonutUI
tagline: 100+ components built with Motion and shadcn/ui
description: A Vercel OSS-backed component set that leans into small, specific interactions (drag-and-drop uploaders, glass-effect audio players, action search bars) rather than generic cards and buttons. Every component installs with a single shadcn CLI command against the KokonutUI registry.

best.title: KokonutUI
best.note: 100+ components, install with npx shadcn add @kokonutui/<name>.
